snippet.title: Goblin Cleanup | Release Date Announcement - TGAGWCAGA Showcase 2024
snippet.description:
Award for Best Game to Play While You Avoid Your Own Cleaning Chores goes to Goblin Cleanup 🏆

The Goblin Cleanup Demo is available on Steam. You can play the demo and wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2748340/Goblin_Cleanup/

Find more amazing games on TGAGWCAGAs Steam Event 👉 http://bit.ly/tagagwcaga-steamsale

Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/tgagwcaga.bsky.social
X: https://x.com/TGAGWCAGA

The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards, or TGAGWCAGA is a showcase that exists because big ideas and small budgets deserve a standing ovation too (and because we love acronyms you can’t pronounce)

This showcase is a love letter to the games that make us laugh, cry, and occasionally yell at our screens in frustration. We’ve gathered an amazing group of devs and studios to celebrate the weird, and wonderful world of indie games.

#goblincleanup #tgagwcaga #tgagwcaga2024
